nls:description: Edit the colors in your code in OKLCH, Display P3 or any of 205 color spaces.
nls:gamut.description: The gamut the picker writes in, for notations that can name wider colors (`oklch()`, `lab()`, `color(display-p3 …)`…). `#hex`, `rgb()`, `hsl()` and `hwb()` are always written inside sRGB.
nls:gamut.p3: Display P3: the wide gamut of current Apple and many other displays
nls:shaders.description: Whether 0–1 vectors in shaders (`vec3`/`vec4` in GLSL, `vec3f` in WGSL, `float3` in HLSL and Metal) are colors, and how to read them. Off by default: a vector is as often a position.
nls:shaders.linear: vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.0) and its kin are linear-light sRGB
nls:shaders.off: Shader vectors aren't read as colors
nls:shaders.srgb: vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.0) and its kin are gamma-encoded sRGB
